decisions.reason: The 2019 award is a strong positive signal that likely put results above aspiration, and a large established firm in a growing industry has enough slack to keep this product.
This probe fits the firm's established geothermal offering, and with no clear evidence of underperformance a large incumbent would usually continue it despite some uncertainty.
The surface-technology line builds on existing capabilities and supports customized solutions, so organizational slack favors retention even though later market success is not visible.
A fire-protection steel profile system is close to the core business and likely strategically useful for construction customers, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.
The slim steel profile system is adjacent to the established profile business, and absent evidence of a clear shortfall management would likely keep it while monitoring performance.
This decorative surface system is somewhat more niche than the others, so its drop risk is higher, but the firm's size and product-market fit still make retention slightly more likely.
